subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model usage logging for cost tracking

question: Should OpenClaw make a core durable completed-call usage ledger the canonical accounting source, or should spend accounting stay on plugin/diagnostic seams for now?
rationale: The evidence shows a real user need, but the right boundary affects core storage policy, privacy, gateway/API contracts, plugin capability design, and future UI/CLI readers, so automation should not choose it unilaterally.

options.title: Design the core ledger first
options.body: Create a maintainer-owned first phase for a canonical SQLite-backed ledger plus transcript backfill and ledger-first readers, then let plugins consume that stable seam.

options.title: Expose a plugin seam first
options.body: Prioritize provider-scoped model-usage plugin delivery and leave durable spend ledgers to ClawHub plugins until native accounting requirements are clearer.

options.title: Defer native accounting
options.body: Keep existing transcript summaries and diagnostics only, and revisit after adjacent usage, auth-profile, and plugin API issues settle.

recommendation.title: Design the core ledger first
recommendation.body: Create a maintainer-owned first phase for a canonical SQLite-backed ledger plus transcript backfill and ledger-first readers, then let plugins consume that stable seam.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on current usage-cost summaries, the usage docs, and the prior ledger-scope review.
